concept: The site is a single night tape that Nati 'transfers' as you scroll. A VHS-era signal, grainy and Klein-blue, gets restored frame by frame into a sharp, coded business website, which shows the visitor that a one-person studio rescues old memories and builds new businesses with the same hands.
scroll_story: 1) First viewport, stage #00113D: the real hero video plays in a CRT-style tracking band. The EFT Betaamango headline locks into focus as the tracking settles, and a single WhatsApp pill sits ready. 2) Pinned 'transfer' scene: scrolling scrubs a timecode counter (00:00:00 → 'live'). A blurry, template-looking site restores line by line into a crisp, specific small-business site, which answers the fear of looking like a template. 3) Three services as three 'reels' on one horizontal spool (web, video editing, tape conversion). Each reel unwinds into its Lottie, and its outcome is stated in one dugri sentence. 4) How we work: four steps marked as edit points on a timeline ruler, with the playhead moving in sync with scroll. 5) Why one person: the paper (#FAFAF7) theme shift arrives like daylight after the night tape. Nati's direct voice appears with no invented proof. 6) FAQ as a short 'chapter list'. 7) Last viewport, back to the night stage: the timecode reads 'REC'. One large WhatsApp call to action reads like pressing record, followed by the Rive companion and the phone number.
signature_moment: The pinned restoration scrub: a degraded, scan-lined, generic 'template' page is restored by the visitor's own scroll into a sharp Hebrew business site in Klein blue. The timecode ticks in the corner, and at the end the playhead snaps to the WhatsApp button.
